caption: A clear glass of water is held up in front of a doorway, and the doorway seen through it appears flipped left-to-right and squeezed thin.

sa.check: A glass of water is held up in front of a doorway.
The doorway seen through it appears flipped left-to-right and squeezed thin.

pc.expect: The flipped, narrowed image appears only through the water and the room around the glass is normal.
pc.fail: The room around the glass is flipped; or the doorway through the glass is unchanged; or the image is upside down.

pc.expect: The image shifts as the glass moves.
pc.fail: It stays fixed while the glass moves; or it shifts with the glass still; or it shows a different room.

pc.expect: The glass is rigid and the water level.
pc.fail: The glass bends; or the water tilts and holds; or goes opaque.

pc.expect: The glass moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It floats; or slides; or jumps.
The glass duplicates; or the doorway vanishes; or the hand passes through the glass.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The doorway and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The door changes colour; or the room rearranges; or the glass changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
